name: Le Meridien Frankfurt
positioning: Art-focused city hotel next to Frankfurt's main train station in the Bahnhofsviertel, with Art Nouveau Palais rooms and skyline-view rooms in the Legacy Wing
best_for: Art lovers who want free entry to the Schirn Kunsthalle and easy walks to the Museum Embankment
Travelers arriving by train who want a base right by the main station

facts.text: Le Meridien Frankfurt is located next to the main train station.
The hotel is set in the Bahnhofsviertel district, close to the main station.
The Chic Palais rooms blend Art Nouveau character with modern amenities.
Rooms in the Legacy Wing look out over the Frankfurt skyline or the green Wiesenhuettenplatz.
The Skyline Suite has a spacious living room with a large table for meetings or private dinners.
Le Meridien Hub displays art pieces from galleries and art studios in the Bahnhofsviertel district.
The fitness terrace has a skyline view.
The Legacy Bar & Grill serves casual, family-style dining, ribs and BBQ specialties from the smoker.
The river Main is a short walk from the hotel, and its embankments make a running path.
Many museums of the Museum Embankment are a few minutes' walk from the hotel.
Messe Frankfurt is about a 15-minute walk from the hotel.

highlights.text: Hotel guests get complimentary access to the Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt through Le Meridien's Unlock Art program.
The Chic Palais rooms contain objects and features dating from as far back as 1905.
The hotel lobby hosts changing exhibition projects of the Staedelschule art academy.
The fitness and sauna area has sun loungers outside on a roof terrace.
The Skyline Suite can be combined with two connecting Deluxe Rooms.

considerations.text: The Roemerberg and the Schirn are about 15 minutes from the hotel on foot along the river Main, so the old town is a walk rather than on the doorstep.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may be busy for leisure travelers seeking a quiet retreat.
